_source: bina-gtm/notes/ESA_State_Database.xlsx — the bina team's ESA database. Sync this file from it; never invent numbers or dates. If a field is unknown, use an honest fallback and flag the gap to the team.

programs.who: Any Alabama K–12 family.
programs.applyWindow: One window a year, in spring. Exact 2026 dates aren't published yet — check the CHOOSE Act site, and we'll confirm timing with you.
programs.approval: The state reviews your application after the window closes and confirms your award before funds are released. We'll tell you what to expect for your bina start on the call.

programs.who: Every Arizona K–12 family — no income requirement.
programs.howMuch: $7,000–$8,000 per child, per year (more for children with special needs).
programs.applyWindow: Open all year. Your quarter depends on when you sign — deadlines are Jun 1, Sep 1, Dec 1 and Mar 1. Applying earlier means funds sooner.
programs.approval: Approval takes up to 30 days. You pre-register, then set up ClassWallet and link your bank. Because your funding quarter is set by your contract-signing date, signing with bina early puts you in an earlier funding quarter.
programs.boost: Arizona's handbook explicitly approves “tuition or fees for a nonpublic online learning program” — exactly the category bina is in.

programs.who: Every Arkansas K–12 family.
programs.applyWindow: Mar 9 – Jun 1, 2026. Finish your application or renewal by Jun 1 to secure your child's place for 2026–27.
programs.approval: Applications are reviewed in priority windows; expect a response about 7–10 business days after you submit your documents. Funds then arrive quarterly through ClassWallet.

programs.who: Most Florida families.
programs.howMuch: About $8,200 per child, per year (more for children with special needs).
programs.applyWindow: Applications open in cycles through the year. You start by contacting Step Up for Students or AAA Scholarship Foundation.
programs.approval: bina isn't a direct Florida provider yet, so today this works through reimbursement — you're funded, then submit bina's invoice, enrollment letter and teacher credentials to claim it. We map your exact path on the call before you spend anything.

programs.who: Families under the income limit whose child is zoned for certain public schools.
programs.applyWindow: The portal reopens each period. Use the pre-screen tool at mygeorgiapromise.org to check eligibility, then apply.
programs.approval: After the window closes, applications are reviewed — expect about 60 days. Your student's status updates in stages in the portal, so you'll see exactly where you stand before we set your bina start.

programs.who: Idaho families with a child in nonpublic school (ages 5–19).
programs.howMuch: Up to $5,000 per child, per year ($7,500 for children with special needs).
programs.applyWindow: The second 2026 window opens May 21; apply by Aug 15.
programs.approval: This is a tax credit or advance payment: you apply, submit your bina tuition receipts, and receive a refundable credit or advance payment. We supply the receipts you need.

programs.who: Children with a qualifying disability (and their siblings).
programs.howMuch: Up to $20,000 per child, per year ($8,000 for a sibling).
programs.applyWindow: One window a year — check the official site for 2026 dates.
programs.approval: Approval timelines vary — we'll tell you what to expect for your bina start on the call.

programs.who: Every Iowa K–12 family.
programs.applyWindow: Applications open in late spring — check the official site for exact 2026 dates.
programs.approval: Once approved, funds are placed in your Odyssey account. We'll confirm timing for your bina start on the call.

programs.who: Lower-income Kansas families.
programs.howMuch: Up to $8,000 per child, per year.
programs.applyWindow: Windows vary by scholarship organization — check the official site.
programs.approval: Approval runs through an approved scholarship organization. We'll help you understand the timeline before you commit to a bina start.

programs.who: Louisiana families — priority by income and disability.
programs.howMuch: $7,626 per child, per year (up to $15,253 for a qualifying disability).
programs.approval: Review is rolling. Your dashboard shows your student as Under Review, then Eligible or Ineligible — so you'll know your status before we lock a bina start.

programs.who: Children with a qualifying special-education need.
programs.applyWindow: One window a year — check the official site for 2026 dates.
programs.approval: Approval timelines vary — we'll tell you what to expect for your bina start on the call.

programs.who: Priority for lower-income families and children with disabilities.
programs.howMuch: Varies by need (up to about $11,800 for special needs).
programs.applyWindow: One window a year — check the official site for 2026 dates.
programs.approval: Approval timelines vary — we'll tell you what to expect for your bina start on the call.

programs.who: Children with special needs.
programs.applyWindow: On hold — confirm the program is active before planning around it.
programs.approval: The program is paused by a lawsuit, so approvals are uncertain right now. Talk to us and we'll flag you the moment it reopens.
programs.special: This program is paused by a lawsuit. Current students get reimbursements through June 30, 2026; new enrollment is uncertain.

programs.who: Families under the state income limit.
programs.applyWindow: Rolling. Submit your documents by July 1 to clear the July 15 funding deadline.
programs.approval: Expect a response within about 30 days; if they ask for more documents it can take up to two months. Funds then arrive in four installments (September, November, January, April).

programs.who: Children with a disability (ESA+), or most families (Opportunity Scholarship).
programs.howMuch: $9,000 per child (ESA+, more for special needs); $3,600–$7,900 (Opportunity Scholarship).
programs.applyWindow: One window a year — check the official site for 2026 dates.
programs.approval: Approval timelines vary — we'll tell you what to expect for your bina start on the call.

programs.who: Every Ohio family (the amount scales with income).
programs.applyWindow: One window a year — check the official site for 2026 dates.
programs.approval: Approval timelines vary — we'll tell you what to expect for your bina start on the call.

programs.who: Every family (the credit scales with income).
programs.applyWindow: One window a year — check the official site for 2026 dates.
programs.approval: Approval timelines vary — we'll tell you what to expect for your bina start on the call.

programs.who: Families under the income limit.
programs.applyWindow: Join the 2026–27 waitlist now at sc-estf-program.com. Disbursements come quarterly (July, September, December, February).
programs.approval: You'll hear the state's decision within 10 business days; if approved, ClassWallet emails you within 3 business days to finish setup. Funds come through the digital wallet — there's no pay-out-of-pocket-and-reimburse option here.

programs.who: Most Tennessee families.
programs.applyWindow: One window a year — check the official site for 2026 dates.
programs.approval: Approval timelines vary — we'll tell you what to expect for your bina start on the call.

programs.who: Every Texas family.
programs.howMuch: $10,474 per child for the 2026–27 school year.
programs.applyWindow: Feb 4 – Mar 17, 2026 (opens 9 a.m. CT, closes 11:59 p.m. CT).
programs.approval: Funding and waitlist status is posted in your Odyssey portal; initial funding lands July 1. You'll name bina as your school in the portal and we confirm your enrollment back — so nothing falls through the cracks.

programs.who: Every Utah K–12 family (awards are limited, so not everyone who applies is funded).
programs.applyWindow: New students: Apr 1 – May 1, 2026 (returning families from Mar 1). The 2026–27 window has closed — apply the day the next one opens.
programs.approval: Approval takes about a month. Awards are announced June 16 and you accept by June 30. Because awards aren't guaranteed, we plan your bina start around your notification date.
programs.special: A court appeal is pending; the program continues during the appeal. Awards aren't guaranteed — apply as early as possible.

programs.who: Most families leaving public school or just starting school.
programs.applyWindow: Opens Mar 2, 2026. Apply by Jun 15, 2026 for 100% of the award — later windows fund 75%, then 50%, then 25%.
programs.approval: Once approved, funds are deposited to your Hope account in two halves (by August 15 and mid-year). Applying in the first window secures the full award, which we factor into your bina start.

programs.who: Families under the program income limits.
programs.applyWindow: One window a year — check the official site for 2026 dates.
programs.approval: Approval timelines vary — we'll tell you what to expect for your bina start on the call.

programs.who: Most Wyoming families.
programs.applyWindow: Opens July 6, 2026 at 9 a.m. and runs to the end of July. Returning families renew with pre-filled forms.
programs.approval: Wyoming verifies eligibility by the end of July, and your $7,000 lands in your Odyssey account by September 1. Returning families also get an extra $1,750 in rollover funds — we time your bina start to your funding date.
